title: Scripting Isn't Easy on Godot Mobile — Gboard's Slide Gesture Conflicts with Indentation and Cursor Movement
body:
### Tested versions

Was available on each version of Android (Google Play one) and even on the current Google Play 4.4.1 stable

### System information

Iqoo Z6 lite 5g , Funtouch OS 14

### Issue description

When using the Godot Android app with the Gboard keyboard, the gesture feature to slide the spacebar for moving the cursor (commonly used for precise cursor placement) doesn't work reliably. This results in difficulty fixing indentation errors or selecting specific text horizontally, which is a major hindrance when editing GDScript on mobile.

This problem affects usability and makes scripting very frustrating on Android, especially when trying to correct indentation issues or navigate lines of code precisely.

(Gboard allows the gesture to be used even in both landscape and portrait mode)

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to Reproduce:

1. Download the Godot Engine Android app from the Google Play Store.


2. Open the app, create a new project.


3. Add a Node and save the scene.


4. Add a new script to the node.


5. Begin typing some GDScript code.


6. Try using Gboard's sliding spacebar gesture to move the cursor horizontally within a line of code (common for editing or fixing indentation).


7. Observe that the gesture either doesn't work properly or results in unwanted behavior.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A – This bug occurs in any new project. Just create a new scene with a Node and add a script. The Gboard slide gesture (spacebar swipe to move the cursor) doesn't work properly in the script editor on Android.
